cohort: 117 pregnant women with threatened abortion and an equal number of asymptomatic pregnant women receiving antenatal care at Travancore Medical College Hospital, Kollam, India between January 2021 and January 2023.
finding: Women with threatened abortion had a significantly higher rate of spontaneous abortion (15.38%) compared to the control group (5.1%), and increased odds of placenta previa, pre-mature rupture of membranes, post-partum hemorrhage, and pre-term birth.
